# Comor Sports

> > Vancouver's premier outdoor sports retailer specializing in ski, snowboard, and bike equipment since 1974

Comor Sports operates three locations across British Columbia (Kitsilano, North Vancouver, and Whistler) offering premium outdoor gear from brands like Burton, Lib Tech, Specialized, Salomon, and The North Face. They provide expert services including ski/snowboard tuning by Crystal Glide, bike maintenance, and Retül bike fitting.

## Key Topics

- Ski equipment and bindings
- Snowboard gear (boards, boots, bindings)
- Mountain and electric bikes
- Outdoor apparel and accessories
- Ski and snowboard tuning services
- Bike maintenance and repairs
- Avalanche safety equipment
- Vancouver outdoor sports community
- Burton, Lib Tech, Salomon, Specialized
- Backcountry and freeride gear
- Canada shipping and store pickup
- Winter sports expertise
- Tubeless bike setup
- Look Pivot bindings
- Protect Our Winters Canada partnership
